name: Drive Them Out
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Hear my words well: we will not yield a single blade of grass to the centaur.

Go to their camp now, before they have rested and have a chance to ride to our village. Slaughter them all. Ensure none escape to the Barrens to rally others to their aid.

If you find the leader of this would-be raiding party, bring me his head so that it may serve as a warning to others who dare tread on our ancestral homeland.
narrative.objectives: Kill 6 Galak Centaurs, 4 Galak Outrunners, and bring the head of Herak the Pillager to Baine Bloodhoof.
narrative.offerRewardText: You are covered in centaur blood. Remember this feeling. It is an honor unlike any other among our people.I could hear the moment the last fell, and their thunderous stampede echoed no longer. Well done!Today marks a great victory for our village, and a security our young ones need now more than ever. You have my deepest thanks, young champion.
